The use of `sha256sums=('SKIP')` is normal for VCS packages and does not pose a risk during `--printsrcinfo`, as no sources are downloaded or verified at this stage.

All function bodies are ignored during this phase, so even if they contained suspicious logic (which they do not), it would not affect the safety of this operation. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for `--printsrcinfo` poses no immediate security risk.
